items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: And they had one of my old players I had in my band in Camp Pike. Georgia Boyd on Clannett.

ctx.x: How did you happen to hire Papa Teal?

Near the clarinet. George Field. See, I get Papa. See, I get Papa. George Field. We played and played and played. The arrangement was made. Randy. After Parker Brothers, John Daniels, John Daniels, Harry Brooks and Kit Harris. They were his friends from New York. They know each other as well. Well, they spoke at Harry Parker. He had his bartender at the 101 Ranch with Jew Morris. And a great friend to Billy Phillip. So, they said, Why don't you give Billy the preference? All right. Tell Billy about it. Jew Morris…

A fine gentleman. Came down to make the arrangement. He buys the place, 101 Ranch. I heard him speak over conversations. No oppositions. Taking my girls out of here, over to your place. Come to the agreement. No oppositions. Well, they ran. Barely opened up. They had Fair Bear Ridley. Dave Argan on drums. And they had Lee Collin on trumpet. And they had one of my old players I had in my band in Camp Pike. Georgia Boyd on Clannett. Well, they ran. Everything ran all right. Until the Easter comes on. On Easter…

items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: I learned the fellas being out there in the camp at Georgia Boyd. I go and get Georgia, tell Lieutenant, I go and get Georgia Boyd.

ctx.x: That's all right, go ahead. Finish the story. Yeah. Anyway, ask Mr. Horace.

Well, after I got there, some recommendations, I had two of the boys from Bomb Bell Circus, two trumpet players. And of course they played circus style. We had a rehearsal. And I learned the fellas being out there in the camp at Georgia Boyd. I go and get Georgia, tell Lieutenant, I go and get Georgia Boyd. I got Walter Preston. You remember Walter Preston? He used to play banjo with Crisco? Yeah. Yes I do. Got him. And I went for Yank. Yank came around to the place. He goes for Lieutenant, Lieutenant Fleming…
